mapper.select: SELECT ev.id AS id, file.path AS thumbNail, hos.city AS city, hos.district AS district, hos.name AS hospitalName, ev.name AS name, ev.consult_count AS counselCount, ev.price AS cost FROM t_event ev JOIN t_hospital hos ON hos.id = ev.hospital_id LEFT JOIN t_files file on ev.image_group_id = file.group_id WHERE ev.id = #{eventId} AND ev.state = 'ACTIVE' AND file.file_order = 1;
SELECT * FROM t_event WHERE state = 'ACTIVE' AND hospital_id = #{hospitalId}

SELECT h.event_id AS id, count(*), e.name, e.consult_count AS counselCount, e.price AS cost, hs.name AS hospitalName, hs.city, hs.district, f.path AS thumbNail FROM t_event_history h LEFT JOIN T_EVENT e ON h.event_id = e.id LEFT JOIN T_HOSPITAL hs ON e.hospital_id = hs.id LEFT JOIN T_FILES f ON e.image_group_id = f.group_id WHERE h.before_event_id = #{eventId} AND f.file_order = 1 GROUP BY h.event_id, e.name, e.consult_count, e.price, hs.name, hs.city, hs.district, f.path ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT e.id AS id, f.path AS thumbNail, h.city AS city, h.district AS district, h.name AS hospitalName, e.name AS name, e.consult_count AS counselCount, e.price AS cost FROM t_event e JOIN t_hospital h ON h.id = e.hospital_id LEFT JOIN t_files f on e.image_group_id = f.group_id WHERE e.promotion_group_id = #{promotionGroupId} AND e.state = 'ACTIVE' AND e.type = 'PROMOTION' AND e.date_started < NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ AND e.date_end > NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ AND f.file_order = 1 ORDER BY e.exposed_rank LIMIT 3;

SELECT ev.id AS id, file.path AS thumbNail, hos.city AS city, hos.district AS district, hos.name AS hospitalName, ev.name AS name, ev.consult_count AS counselCount, ev.price AS cost FROM t_event ev JOIN t_hospital hos ON hos.id = ev.hospital_id LEFT JOIN t_files file ON ev.image_group_id = file.group_id WHERE file.file_order = 1 AND ev.state = 'ACTIVE' AND ev.id = #{eventId};
SELECT * FROM t_event WHERE state = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY date_created desc LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page} * #{size};
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_event WHERE state = 'ACTIVE' AND type = 'EVENT' AND date_started < NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ AND date_end > NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ;
